about: User programs recorded from the real toolchain by scripts/record_user_programs.py. Each source is stored as the app sends it (a safe file name, normalised text); its recording is the directory of the same stem. outcome is how POST /api/programs answers it. withinSeconds bounds a fresh compile through the real stack.
